about: Tenant in Pune; whole Rs 60,000 deposit withheld for painting and a tap. Four rounds of consultation (questions, answers, a settlement offer to refuse), then a legal notice sent personally.

turns.text: Hi, I need help. I was renting a 2BHK flat in Baner, Pune from Mr. Suresh Kulkarni from 1 November 2024. I paid a security deposit of Rs 60,000 by bank transfer. I vacated on 30 September 2026 after giving one month's notice on WhatsApp. Now he is refusing to return the deposit. He says he will deduct for painting the whole flat and for a broken bathroom tap. What can I do?

To answer your questions:
1. Yes, there is a registered 11-month leave and licence agreement, renewed in October 2025. Clause 7 says the deposit is refundable at the end "after deducting for damages, if any". It says nothing about painting.
2. Yes. I have dated photos from when I moved in (1 November 2024) and dated photos and a video of every room taken on 30 September 2026 when I handed over the keys. The walls only have normal marks from two years of living.
3. I handed the keys to his son Rohan at the flat on 30 September at about 6 pm. The same evening Mr. Kulkarni messaged me on WhatsApp: "keys received". I have that message.
Some more facts: I paid the deposit by NEFT on 28 October 2024 and I have the bank statement. The only thing broken was the bathroom tap washer, which had been leaking since June; I told him on WhatsApp in June and he said he would send a plumber but never did. On 3 October he messaged: "painting will cost 35,000 and plumbing 5,000, rest I will see". Since then he has not paid anything and stopped replying. Rent was Rs 22,000 a month and I paid everything up to September, no dues. I now live in Wakad, Pune.

His address is B-404, Pride Panorama, Baner, Pune 411045.

An update: he finally replied yesterday (6 November 2026). He says he will keep Rs 40,000 and return only Rs 20,000, and only "if you sign that you have no further claims". Should I accept? What if he argues the flat needed painting because I lived there for two years? I want the full amount back, but I am willing to pay a fair cost for the tap washer if he shows a bill. Also, if he still doesn't pay after a notice, where exactly do I file and how long will it take?

I won't sign that. I'd like to send him a proper legal notice myself, not through a lawyer. My name is Ananya Deshpande and my new address is Flat 12, Sai Residency, Wakad, Pune 411057. Please prepare the notice, and tell me exactly how to send it so I have proof of delivery.

about: Defective phone from an online marketplace, return rejected as 'physical damage'. Grievance officer and NCH 1915 first, then a District Commission complaint against both seller and platform.

turns.text: Maine 18 October 2026 ko ek online marketplace (ShopKart) se Rs 15,999 ka phone liya. 20 October ko delivery hui aur 2 din mein screen pe green line aa gayi aur touch bhi theek se kaam nahi kar raha. Return request daali to 'physical damage' bol ke reject kar di, jabki phone pe ek scratch bhi nahi hai. Main bahut pareshan hu, ye phone maine apni pehli salary se liya tha. Ab kya karu?

Haan, mere paas unboxing video hai, aur green line wali screen ki photos aur video bhi hain. Baaki details:
1. Payment UPI se kiya tha, invoice mere email pe hai. Seller ka naam 'MobiWorld Retail' hai, ShopKart sirf platform hai.
2. Customer care se 3 baar baat ki, ticket number SK-88213. Har baar bolte hain 'decision final hai'.
3. 1 November ko brand ke authorised service centre gaya tha. Unhone job sheet di jisme likha hai 'display panel defect, no physical damage', lekin bole replacement ke liye seller se baat karo.
4. Main Lucknow mein rehta hu.
5. Mujhe paisa wapas chahiye ya naya phone, aur jo pareshani hui uska compensation bhi.

4 November ko ShopKart ke grievance officer ko email kiya, abhi tak jawab nahi aaya. NCH 1915 pe bhi complaint kar di, docket number NCH-2026-1104-7781. Kitna compensation maang sakta hu? Aur kya ShopKart aur seller dono ke khilaf case ho sakta hai? Kya mujhe vakil chahiye ya main khud complaint file kar sakta hu?

Theek hai. Agar 15 din mein unka jawab nahi aaya to main District Commission, Lucknow jaunga. Mera naam Rohit Verma hai, address 22, Vipul Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow 226010. Consumer complaint ka draft bana do, dono ke khilaf.

about: Three months' salary unpaid after resignation from a private company in Noida, PF stopped, HR offers half. Labour-department route, then a legal notice.

turns.text: मैंने नोएडा की एक प्राइवेट कंपनी (टेकनोवा सॉल्यूशंस प्रा. लि.) में 2 साल सॉफ्टवेयर टेस्टर के रूप में काम किया। मेरी सैलरी ₹42,000 महीना थी। जुलाई, अगस्त और सितंबर 2026 की सैलरी नहीं मिली। मैंने 15 सितंबर को इस्तीफा दिया और 30 सितंबर मेरा आखिरी दिन था। HR बस कहता है 'अगले महीने'। घर का किराया और EMI भरना मुश्किल हो गया है। मैं क्या करूँ?

आपके सवालों के जवाब:
1. मेरे पास ऑफर लेटर, अपॉइंटमेंट लेटर और जून 2026 तक की सैलरी स्लिप हैं। जुलाई और अगस्त की पे-स्लिप पोर्टल पर बनी हैं, पर पैसा खाते में नहीं आया; बैंक स्टेटमेंट से यह दिखता है।
2. हाँ, मेरे जैसे 8 और लोगों की सैलरी भी रुकी है, हमारा एक व्हाट्सऐप ग्रुप है।
और जानकारी: इस्तीफ़ा ईमेल से भेजा था। HR ने ईमेल पर स्वीकार किया और लिखा कि 'फुल एंड फाइनल सेटलमेंट 45 दिन में होगा'। मेरा पद कोई मैनेजर या सुपरवाइज़र वाला नहीं था। कंपनी ने न कोई कारण बताया, न किसी कटौती की बात की। PF भी जुलाई से जमा नहीं हुआ है। मुझे पूरी बकाया सैलरी ₹1,26,000 और देरी का ब्याज चाहिए।

HR ने कल व्हाट्सऐप पर लिखा कि 'कंपनी घाटे में है, दिसंबर तक आधा पैसा देंगे'। क्या मुझे यह मान लेना चाहिए? अगर मैं आधा पैसा ले लूँ तो क्या बाकी का दावा खत्म हो जाएगा? और श्रम विभाग में शिकायत कैसे करूँ? PF के लिए क्या करूँ?
ठीक है, पहले कंपनी को कानूनी नोटिस भेजना चाहता हूँ। मैं खुद भेजूँगा। मेरा नाम अमित कुमार है, पता 45, सेक्टर 62, नोएडा 201309। ड्राफ्ट बना दीजिए, उसमें PF और ब्याज की माँग भी हो।

about: Textile-shop worker in Chennai, two months' cash wages unpaid, no contract; the owner then alleges theft and threatens police. A legal notice that also denies the theft allegation.

turns.text: நான் சென்னை தி.நகரில் ஒரு ஜவுளிக் கடையில் 3 வருடமாக விற்பனை உதவியாளராக வேலை செய்தேன். மாதச் சம்பளம் ₹14,000. ஆகஸ்ட், செப்டம்பர் இரண்டு மாத சம்பளம் கொடுக்கவில்லை. அக்டோபர் 5 அன்று எந்தக் காரணமும் சொல்லாமல் என்னை வேலையை விட்டு போகச் சொன்னார்கள். என் குடும்பம் என் சம்பளத்தை நம்பி இருக்கிறது. நான் என்ன செய்வது?

உங்கள் கேள்விகளுக்கு பதில்:
1. எழுத்துப்பூர்வ ஒப்பந்தமோ நியமனக் கடிதமோ இல்லை. ஆனால் வருகைப் பதிவேட்டில் தினமும் கையெழுத்து போட்டேன்.
2. என்னுடன் வேலை செய்த செல்வி சாட்சியாக வர தயாராக இருக்கிறார். அவருக்கும் ஒரு மாத சம்பளம் பாக்கி.
3. சம்பளம் பெரும்பாலும் ரொக்கமாக கொடுத்தார்கள், சில மாதங்கள் GPay மூலம் வந்தது; அந்த GPay பதிவுகள் என்னிடம் உள்ளன.
மேலும்: கடை உரிமையாளர் திரு. ராஜேந்திரன் வாட்ஸ்அப்பில் 'அடுத்த வாரம் தருகிறேன்' என்று குரல் செய்தி அனுப்பினார். அது என்னிடம் உள்ளது. பாக்கி சம்பளம் ஆகஸ்ட், செப்டம்பர் இரண்டு மாதம் மட்டும் - மொத்தம் ₹28,000.

இப்போது அவர் 'நீ கடையில் துணி திருடினாய், அதனால் சம்பளம் இல்லை' என்று சொல்கிறார். அது முற்றிலும் பொய். எந்த புகாரும் இதுவரை கொடுக்கப்படவில்லை. போலீஸில் புகார் கொடுப்பேன் என்று மிரட்டுகிறார். நான் பயப்பட வேண்டுமா? அவர் உண்மையில் புகார் கொடுத்தால் என்ன ஆகும்? நான் என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?

சரி. அவருக்கு சட்ட நோட்டீஸ் அனுப்ப விரும்புகிறேன். நானே அனுப்புவேன். என் பெயர் கவிதா முருகன், முகவரி 12, வள்ளுவர் தெரு, சைதாப்பேட்டை, சென்னை 600015. வரைவு தயார் செய்யுங்கள்; திருட்டு குற்றச்சாட்டை மறுப்பதும் அதில் இருக்கட்டும்.

about: AC bought in 2023, compressor failed, company kept promising until January 2025. Is it time-barred? Limitation, the written promise, and a consumer complaint with an alternative prayer to condone delay.

turns.text: I bought a split AC for Rs 38,000 from a brand's showroom in Ahmedabad in March 2023. The compressor failed in August 2023, inside the 1-year warranty (the compressor had a 5-year warranty). The company refused to repair it in October 2023, saying 'voltage damage'. Can I still file a consumer case now?

1. Yes, the refusal came by email on 12 October 2023 from their service centre: "compressor failure due to voltage fluctuation, not covered".
2. Yes, I used the stabilizer they themselves recommended and installed; it is on the installation sheet.
But I kept following up. I have emails to the company in November 2023, March 2024 and October 2024. On 15 January 2025 their regional service manager emailed me promising a free replacement compressor "within 30 days", but nothing happened. I have the invoice, the warranty card and the technician's service report that says only "compressor failure"; it does not mention voltage. I didn't file earlier because they kept promising.

So am I late? Does the January 2025 promise restart the 2 years? How do I explain the delay to the Commission? What can I claim: the AC price, a new compressor, compensation for two summers without AC?

Please draft the consumer complaint for the District Commission, Ahmedabad, with the delay explained and a separate request to condone it. I'm Hetal Patel, B-21, Shivalik Bungalows, Satellite, Ahmedabad 380015.

My first preference is a working replacement AC or a refund of Rs 38,000. For harassment and mental agony I want to claim Rs 25,000, plus Rs 10,000 litigation costs. And please keep the request to condone delay in the complaint as a backup, in case the Commission disagrees that I'm within time.

3. Yes, dated photos at move-in and a video at move-out. I lived there 2 years with normal use; I even had the flat cleaned before leaving.

Rent was paid till October, no dues. I'd still like to try one phone call before anything formal. Can I practise the call with you first?
Hello uncle, this is Priya, your tenant from the Lajpat Nagar flat. I'm calling about my deposit of Rs 50,000. I'd like the full amount back this week, please.

Uncle, thank you for sending the 35,000. But painting after two years is normal wear and tear; that is the owner's cost, not the tenant's, and our agreement says nothing about painting or cleaning charges. I also had the flat cleaned before leaving, and I have photos and a video from the day I handed over the keys.

Uncle, I understand. If you can show me a real bill for actual damage beyond normal use, I'll look at it fairly. Otherwise please transfer the remaining 15,000 by Friday. I'd much rather we settle it between us, but if not I'll have to send a legal notice, and I really don't want that.

Uncle, I appreciate the 5,000, but without any bill the deduction isn't fair. Please send the remaining 15,000 by Friday and we close this happily. I'll message you on WhatsApp after this call so we both have it in writing.

about: Online blackmail: ex-partner threatens to post private photos unless paid, and the demand escalates. Safety first, cyber reporting, evidence; then a police complaint and an advocate's legal notice.

turns.text: My ex-boyfriend Rahul is threatening me. On 28 October 2026 he sent me a WhatsApp saying 'pay 50,000 or I post your private photos on Instagram and send them to your office'. We broke up in August. I haven't paid anything. I'm really scared and I can't sleep. What can I do?

1. Yes. I have screenshots of all his messages with dates and times, showing his WhatsApp number (+91 99XXX 80312). One message also came from his Instagram account @rahul.v.92.
2. As far as I know he hasn't posted or sent anything yet.
3. No, I haven't told the police or my family yet.
More facts: the photos were taken during our relationship; I never agreed to them being shared with anyone. I live in Delhi, I'm 26 and work at a private firm.

He messaged again today. Now he wants Rs 1 lakh by Friday and says he'll make a fake account and tag my colleagues. Should I block him? Should I go to the police station or report online? Will my name become public? And if he does post them, how fast can they be taken down?

I want to file a police complaint myself, and also have a lawyer send him a legal notice so he knows I'm serious. Please draft both. My name is Riya Sharma. I don't know his home address, only his number and Instagram.

about: Woman beaten by her husband, pushed out of the in-laws' house with her child. Safety first, then residence, maintenance, stridhan and protection under the DV Act; a DV Act application.

turns.text: Mera pati mujhe 2 saal se maarta hai. 25 October 2026 ko unhone mujhe aur meri 4 saal ki beti ko sasural se nikal diya. Abhi main apne mayke mein hu, Bhopal mein. Saas bhi gaali deti thi aur dahej ke liye taane deti thi. Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha kya karu. Mujhe kya karna chahiye?

Aapke sawaalon ke jawab:
1. Haan. 12 August 2026 ko unhone mujhe itna maara ki haath mein fracture hua. Hamidia hospital (sarkari) mein ilaaj hua, record mere paas hai, lekin police mein report nahi ki.
2. Nahi, abhi tak koi police complaint ya court case kisi taraf se nahi hua.
3. Saas ke kuch WhatsApp voice notes hain jisme woh "maayke se paise lao" bolti hain. Pati ke messages mein gaali hai.
Aur: shaadi March 2021 mein Bhopal mein hui thi. Sasural ka ghar mere sasur ke naam pe hai, hum wahi rehte the. Pati ek private company mein kaam karte hain, lagbhag Rs 70,000 mahina kamate hain. Main kaam nahi karti. Mere gehne aur shaadi ka saaman sasural mein hi hai. Beti mere saath hai.

Kya main wapas us ghar mein reh sakti hu, jabki ghar sasur ke naam pe hai? Beti ke school aur kharche ka kya? Mere gehne kaise wapas milenge? Aur kya police mein bhi complaint karni chahiye ya sirf court? Mujhe darr hai ki complaint ki to woh aur gussa honge.

Theek hai. Main 181 pe call karke Protection Officer se milungi. Mujhe DV Act ki application ka draft chahiye, jisme ghar mein rehne ka haq, mere aur beti ke liye kharcha, gehne wapas, aur protection order sab ho. Mera naam Pooja Sharma hai.
